consumer: catalogue.py search and facets; OKF Explorer with recorded Chrome acceptance
count_policy: Distinct repositories per value; overlapping values are not additive; counts reflect the selected search and filters.

facets.label: Subject domain
facets.question: Which public-service subject might this address?
facets.description: Unreviewed name/description classification; unclassified is retained.

facets.label: Engineering task
facets.question: What might I use this for?
facets.description: Unreviewed task suggestions with matched-term evidence.

facets.label: Type of content
facets.question: Is this likely code, documentation, data or infrastructure?
facets.description: Multiple suggested types from names/descriptions; code has not been inspected.

facets.label: Hosting account
facets.question: Which GitHub account hosts it?
facets.description: Source account, not verified legal owner or service operator.

facets.label: Primary language
facets.question: Which primary language does GitHub report?
facets.description: One primary language; not all languages or dependency ecosystems.

facets.label: Language family
facets.question: Which language family could guide analysis tooling?
facets.description: Editorial grouping of the reported language; no build-system claim.

facets.label: Reported licence
facets.question: What licence identifier is reported?
facets.description: Not legal clearance. Unknown and NOASSERTION remain unresolved.

facets.label: Licence evidence
facets.question: Is there a usable reported identifier to inspect?
facets.description: Identifier presence is metadata, not permission.

facets.label: Archive status
facets.question: Is the repository marked archived?
facets.description: Archive flag does not establish current operational use.

facets.label: Fork status
facets.question: Is it a fork, a source repository or unknown?
facets.description: Missing fork metadata remains unknown.

facets.label: Time since code push
facets.question: When was code last pushed relative to this snapshot?
facets.description: Date bands are not a maintenance, support or security rating.

facets.label: Code push year
facets.question: Which year was the last recorded code push?
facets.description: Code activity date, distinct from metadata updates and observation time.

facets.label: Description available
facets.question: Is there a description to support discovery?
facets.description: The build does not fetch README content.

facets.label: SBOM link reported
facets.question: Does the feed provide an SBOM reference?
facets.description: A path is not a successful fetch, a current SBOM or security evidence.

facets.label: Reported package version resolution
facets.question: Are unresolved versions likely to limit advisory matching?
facets.description: Upstream quality-report classifications; not independently resolved versions or vulnerability results.

facets.label: Reported dependency context
facets.question: Which runtime, build, CI or unresolved groups need investigation?
facets.description: Package-name heuristics from upstream; build and CI dependencies remain relevant to supply-chain risk.

facets.label: Reported package count band
facets.question: How large is the reported inventory to investigate?
facets.description: Package observations per SBOM report, not distinct packages across government.

facets.label: Quality report age at snapshot
facets.question: How old was the aggregate quality report when captured?
facets.description: The report generation date does not establish individual SBOM creation dates.

facets.label: History collection coverage
facets.question: Has GitHub history been collected, is it pending or unavailable?
facets.description: Collection coverage is separate from code activity.

facets.label: Recent reported commit count
facets.question: How many commits are reported in 13 complete weeks?
facets.description: Default-branch statistics exclude merge and empty commits; not a quality measure.

facets.label: Line-change data availability
facets.question: Does the provider supply usable line-change observations?
facets.description: Large repositories can return zero line counts; those are retained as unknown or omitted.

facets.label: Recent contributor account
facets.question: Which accounts contributed in the complete recent window?
facets.description: Public GitHub accounts; not verified people, maintainers or approvers.

facets.label: Historical contributor account
facets.question: Which accounts appear in the available default-branch history?
facets.description: Historical contribution is not present ownership or scan authority.

facets.label: Catalogue change status
facets.question: Did the source metadata change since the prior admitted snapshot?
facets.description: Metadata changes are separate from code changes; first observations have no baseline.

facets.label: Number of source fields changed
facets.question: How many metadata fields changed?
facets.description: A count of changed catalogue fields, not code churn or impact.
